name: Boku no Sensei
source:
Main character approaches an important exam, so he asks his two female cousins to tutor him. They are very eager to share their experience. But why do they bring cosplay costumes?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-september-2006-pp.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公即将面临一场重要考试，于是请两名表姐妹为自己补习。她们非常热心地想分享经验，但为什么会带来角色扮演服装？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-september-2006-pp.html]vndbreview[/url]]
